The rocket company that has now launched 97 times
caption:
Rocket Lab launched its Electron rocket for the 97th time, lifting off from Launch Complex 1 in New Zealand. The small rocket carries satellites into orbit quickly and affordably, at a pace only a handful of companies on Earth can keep up with.

While SpaceX gets most of the attention, Rocket Lab has quietly built one of the most consistent launch records in the industry. Electron stands 18 meters tall and carries up to 300kg to orbit per mission. Getting to 97 launches in under a decade puts them in very rare company.
